name: Tonghua Dongbao Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: Tonghua Dongbao Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of biological products, traditional Chinese medicines, chemical medicines, and other drugs in China and internationally. The company offers liraglutide injections; insulin glargine injections; insulin aspart injections; human insulin injections; isophane protamine human insulin injections; mixed protamine human insulin injections; suganning capsules; pediatric paracetamol and artificial cow-bezoar and chlorphenamine maleate granules; zhennaoning capsules; compound methionine and choline bitartrate tablets; and compound kushen changyankang tablets.
